rationale: Rubric 2026-11-08 00:5xZ. Operator chose exclude-with-ceiling: a task PR with a live inflight claim or a queued repair manifest drops out of the count that blocks new claims (limit stays executors.max), AND total open task PRs of any state may not exceed openPrLimit + executors.max (6 today); the ceiling is a tightening (class a) added to this option. Counter-argument: plain exclusion suffices and the fleet-wide push failure is a bug to fix; rejected because that failure happened twice on 2026-11-07 and each time the cap turned a bug into a stall (DEC-0398 deadlock), while plain exclusion would have let dispatch open three more doomed PRs. Raise-limit-5 rejected: moves the number, keeps the rule. Implementation: AISDLC-1234.
